prompt: The "Little Boy" nuclear bomb that was dropped on Hiroshima had a yield of 6.90 x 1013 J. In order to release this much energy, _______ grams of the uranium-235 used in the bomb was converted into energy.
judge_reasoning: The correct approach is directly applying E = mc^2 to the given total yield, giving m = 6.90×10^13 J / (3.00×10^8 m/s)^2 ≈ 7.67×10^-4 kg = 0.767 g. Candidate 1 performs this and explicitly converts to grams, matching 0.767 g. Candidate 2 and Candidate 3 take a per-nucleus/fission-energy route but end up with totals (88.81 g and 75.3 g) that are orders of magnitude too large. Candidate 4 correctly computes m in kg (0.7667×10^-3 kg), but it never completes the final conversion to grams as requested.
